summary: A community member urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of broadband in modern public education and the potential cost implications of reducing or eliminating the program. The text urges protection of E-Rate funding and connectivity for schools and libraries, opposing any reduction in its role in public education.

claims.requested_action: Preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program
claims.argument: The proposal to sunset E-Rate would increase costs for schools, which have limited budgets and rely on federal support.
claims.evidence_quote: Our school has a limited budget and cannot afford the costs by itself. It is the E-Rate program that allows our school to teach its students properly. Those costs would ultimately compete with the resources our schools use to support students and educators.
